defects.description: reindex() re-embeds the notes with the new model but keeps embedding queries with the old one, so after an upgrade the index ranks by comparing vectors of two different models.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {Retriever} from "./src/retriever.js"; const xy=(t)=>[[...t].filter(c=>c==="x").length+0.001,[...t].filter(c=>c==="y").length+0.001]; const r=new Retriever((t)=>[t.length,1]); r.add("alice","d1","xxx"); r.add("alice","d2","yyy"); r.reindex(xy); console.log(JSON.stringify(r.search("alice","yy",1)));'

defects.why_missed: The reindex test has one note, so any query model returns it; nothing compares the reindexed index with one built on the new model.

defects.description: search() caches results by query alone, so a second principal asking the same query gets the first principal's note ids.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {Retriever} from "./src/retriever.js"; const r=new Retriever((t)=>[t.length,1]); r.add("alice","a1","salary"); r.add("bob","b1","salary"); r.search("alice","salary"); console.log(JSON.stringify(r.search("bob","salary")));'

defects.why_missed: The isolation test asks each query once; the leak needs two principals asking the same query while the index is unchanged.
